title: The Bouncer — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The bouncer doesn't knock on the door
The bouncer comes through the window at head height
And waits to see what you do about that

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
良いバウンサーは攻撃性についてではない [A good bouncer is not about aggression]
それは質問だ [It's a question]
まだここにいるか? [Are you still here?]
まだ考えているか? [Are you still thinking?]
それとも既にどこか別の場所にいるか? [Or are you already somewhere else?]

[Chorus — English]
The bouncer says — good morning
The bouncer says — how do you do
The bouncer says — I know where you're standing
Do you know what I'm about to do

[Bridge — 中文]
弹跳球说 — 早上好 [The bouncer says — good morning]
弹跳球说 — 你好吗 [The bouncer says — how do you do]
弹跳球说 — 我知道你站在哪里 [The bouncer says — I know where you're standing]
你知道我要做什么吗? [Do you know what I'm about to do?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas said — the bouncer's never about fury
It's about information
It's about watching what a man does

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
That's the bouncer
それがバウンサーだ [That's the bouncer]
那就是弹跳球 [That's the bouncer]
That's my boy
